title: T13 PR B: /onboarding/* endpoints, two-call ask-first (0.6.9, decisions #58, #64, #68)
head: feat/t13-onboarding-endpoints
body:
T13 PR B (decisions #58, #64, #68). Builds on PR A's lazy `garage` bridge.

**What**
- `vendor/`: playbooks **0.2.3** (ships the `onboarding_profile_complete` checker, #64). Built twice from `ee94894`; both builds give sha256 `a1774e9d…`. Hash-pinned; PROVENANCE updated.
- New `anorak.onboarding_service.OnboardingService`, one person per service, holds answers in memory. **Unsaved answers are lost on a service restart**; nothing is kept until the save.
- Routes, token-protected and loopback like `/connectors/*`:
  - `GET /onboarding/screens` returns the 4 intro screens.
  - `GET /onboarding/questions` returns pending questions only, based on the profile on disk plus this session's answers.
  - `POST /onboarding/answer` takes `{question_id, value}` and returns `{pending}`. Unknown id → 400 `unknown_question`; bad body → 400 `invalid_answer`.
  - `POST /onboarding/finish` is two calls (#68):
    - Without a token it returns `needs_confirmation`, a plain-English `preview` and a one-time `confirm_token`, and writes nothing.
    - With the token it runs **write_profile through LoopRunner**: a one-step skill derived from `skill.yaml`, with write_profile in `risky_steps` and garage's checker.
    - Responses: `saved`, `check_failed` (with the checker's text), 409 `confirmation_invalid`, or 409 `paused`.
  - `POST /onboarding/watch-page` takes `{page, decision}`. Not now is never saved.
  - If garage isn't installed, every route returns 503 `onboarding_unavailable`.
- **The ask-first gate is LoopRunner's Confirmation itself.** It approves only a valid, unused token for unchanged answers, once, and uses it up. The early token check is only a fast path. A retry after a failed check needs a new yes, so it stops as `check_failed`. The token is compared with `hmac.compare_digest` and never logged.
- `docs/local-service.md` has an "Onboarding endpoints" section. The desktop-app PR copies it into `docs/local-api.md`.
- Version 0.6.8 → 0.6.9.

**Coordinator changes to the worker's output:** the worker's Confirmation always returned True, with the token checked only before the run. That contradicted #68, so the gate now lives in the Confirmation. Added `test_the_loop_confirmation_refuses_a_bad_token_even_past_the_early_check`, confirmed to fail with the gate removed. The racing-confirms test is labelled as a single-use test, because it doesn't reach the gate. Also removed a redundant cast that failed mypy.

**Tests:** `tests/test_onboarding_endpoints.py`, 17 tests with garage faked, because CI has no vendor wheels. They cover: screens; pending shrinks after an answer; 400s; `access_level` can't be answered; the preview writes nothing; wrong, used and stale tokens get 409; a valid token saves and writes a LoopRunner audit line; the loop gate refuses past the early check; paused → 409; checker failure → `check_failed`; 503 without garage; watch-page yes vs not now; 401 without auth.

**Real-wheel smoke** (local, playbooks 0.2.3, temporary drawer): 4 screens and 13 pending questions; `q_access_level` refused as unknown; preview → confirm → `saved`; saved profile has `access_level: member`; second run has 0 pending; the token is not in the audit.

**Open for the screen PR:** the preview shows venture **codes** (e.g. `holdings`), not full names (Cluer Holdings).
